title: M/s Galaxy Papers Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; additional-security challenge failed by reference
headnote: Writ seeking quash of a para 4.20 additional-security demand was dismissed by adopting the same-date order in connected Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. An earlier 28 May 2014 interim restraint on the demand therefore fell with the dismissal.
facts: Galaxy Papers Pvt. Ltd. challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam's 2 April 2014 notice demanding additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 28 May 2014 a Division Bench connected the writ with WP 51844 of 2009 (Supreme Ceramics Ltd. v. PVVNL), called for a counter, and restrained the demand. On 21 March 2017 the Chief Justice's Bench dismissed the petition, adopting that day's order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.

holding_units.holding: The writ seeking quashing of the 02.04.2014 additional-security demand under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, was dismissed; reasons were to be read from the same-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. The 28.5.2014 interim restraint on demanding additional security stood dissolved.
